# Profile for the REAL Train-Ticket (46 Java/Spring services on minikube, on another machine).
# Usage:   set -a; source profiles/trainticket.env; set +a
# Needs:   ssh tunnels to Prometheus (9090), Jaeger (16686) and the Kubernetes API, and
#          export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/tt-agent-config   (limited service account, not cluster-admin)
# Values marked (TUNE) are first guesses to be replaced by measurements - see docs/TRAINTICKET.md.

# --- what the agent controls and where it reads from
AUTOSCALER_TOPOLOGY=trainticket-live       # whitelist of 11 traced services + seed call graph
AUTODISCOVER_TOPOLOGY=1                    # edges / traffic shares are re-derived from live Jaeger traces
AUTOSCALER_NAMESPACE=default
PROMETHEUS_URL=http://localhost:9090
JAEGER_QUERY_URL=http://localhost:16686
METRICS_SOURCE=trainticket                 # rate/latency from OTel spans, CPU/memory from cAdvisor

# --- show the other running services too (no traces -> isolated nodes, observed only, never controlled)
OBSERVE_UNTRACED=1

# --- timing: JVM pods take tens of seconds to become ready (the demo app: 4 s)
STEP_SECONDS=30
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS=30
METRIC_WINDOW=120s                         # 4x the 30 s cAdvisor scrape interval: a shorter window drops CPU series (see docs/TRAINTICKET.md)
POD_STARTUP_SECONDS=95                     # MEASURED: a new Java pod took 94 s to become Ready
ROLLING_SECONDS_PER_REPLICA=95             # a rolling replacement waits for the same readiness

# --- action bounds sized for Java services (the node has 6 CPUs / 11 GiB, memory is the scarce part)
CPU_MIN=0.25
CPU_MAX=1.0
CPU_QUANTUM=0.05
CPU_DEFAULT=1.0
MEM_MIN_MB=512
MEM_MAX_MB=1024
MEM_QUANTUM_MB=64
MEM_DEFAULT_MB=800
MIN_REPLICAS=1
MAX_REPLICAS=2
INITIAL_REPLICAS=1
# The cost counts EVERY service the agent shows (OBSERVE_UNTRACED=1 -> all ~33 running Deployments at ~0.94 core-equivalents each, ~31 in total), so the budget
# must be per observed service. A fixed CLUSTER_BUDGET_CORES sized for the 11 traced services made the guard refuse every scale-up.
BUDGET_PER_SERVICE=1.25

# --- real-action safety (the node had ~1 GiB of memory free at 11 services; Java pods need ~300-400 MiB each)
SCALE_DOWN_AFTER_UP_STEPS=10               # no scale-down within 5 min of a scale-up: a Java pod takes up to ~4 min to start under a CPU limit
ALLOW_RESIZE=0                             # replica scaling only: a resize is a rolling restart (old + new pod side by side)
NODE_MEMORY_RESERVE_MB=768                 # a scale-up is refused unless the node keeps this much free afterwards
# CONTROLLED_SERVICES=ts-order-service,ts-seat-service,ts-basic-service   # empty = every discovered service
PROMETHEUS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=15              # queries go through an SSH tunnel

# --- trace window (Jaeger is in-memory: keep queries small or it restarts and loses every trace)
JAEGER_LOOKBACK_SECONDS=60
JAEGER_TRACE_LIMIT=200
JAEGER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=20
OTEL_SAMPLE_RATE=1.0                       # (VERIFY) fraction of requests that are traced
# SLO_LATENCY_MS=                          # choose from the measured baseline (p95 was 360-1000 ms at ~12 rps); the
#                                          # default depth formula (370 ms) is not calibrated for this application
